# Seventh Sense Software

> AI-native financial software, and a senior engineering team for finance. 7s.software

## Products
- [GRACE Trader](https://7s.software/grace): an AI-native trading terminal with pro charting, multi-broker execution, natural-language strategies and an AI co-pilot.
- [Case Base](https://7s.software/case-base): crypto forensics with cross-chain tracing, OCR, AI case review, investigative skills and subpoena drafting.
- [Zeppelin](https://7s.software/zeppelin): AI bookkeeping and tax with continuous reconciliation and a live tax position.

## Company
- [Services](https://7s.software/services): trading, market data, exchanges, digital assets, AI agents, compliance and tax engineering. Prices on request.
